$description: Semantic colors over the generated scales in palette.json, assigned by mobile platform conventions (iOS HIG semantic colors, Material 3 roles). A value is one reference used in both modes ("{neutral.12}") or { light, dark }. References: scale steps ({accent.9}, {accent.solid}), black / white, optionally with alpha percent ({black/40}).

base.$description: Screen background for plain lists and content (iOS systemBackground).

grouped.$description: Behind grouped lists and cards (iOS systemGroupedBackground).

raised.$description: Cards and cells on bg.grouped, sheets, the composer (iOS secondarySystemGroupedBackground).

sunken.$description: Text fields and search bars: a flat fill, no inset.

overlay.$description: Custom menus, popovers and toasts; pair with an elevation.

inverse.$description: Snackbars and tooltips; text uses text.inverse.

pressed.$description: Row / cell highlight while pressed on iOS. Android uses the platform ripple instead.

selected.$description: Persistently selected row, chip or segment.

secondary.$description: Secondary buttons and neutral chips (iOS tertiarySystemFill, M3 secondary container).

disabled.$description: Container of a disabled filled control (M3: on-surface 12%).

tertiary.$description: Section headers, timestamps. Short text only (iOS tertiaryLabel).

disabled.$description: Text and icons of disabled controls (M3: on-surface 38%).

tertiary.$description: Decorative only, e.g. the section header plus.

subtle.$description: Hairline list separators, drawn at one physical pixel (iOS separator).

default.$description: 1pt outlines: filter chips, cards that need an edge.

accent.$description: Brand blue hsl(220 82% 65%); dark mode lifts the same hue. Works as the platform tint (iOS tint, M3 primary).

default.$description: Tint: switches, checkmarks, progress, selection, toolbar actions, running state.

solid.$description: Filled primary buttons and the send button, with text.onAccent.

fg.$description: Accent as readable foreground: selected tab label, accent text.

subtle.$description: Tinted background for accent chips and banners (M3 primary container).

default.$description: Destructive icons and text, e.g. a destructive menu item.
Icons and badges. The light brand orange is under 3:1 on white, so light uses the text step.

info.$description: Neutral notices use the accent scale.

state.$description: Session status glyphs. Shape carries meaning too; color is never the only signal.

label.$description: Categorical colors for project labels, tags and avatar backgrounds; hues generated to sit in the theme. fg reads on bg.base and on the matching bg.

syntax.$description: Syntax highlighting on code.bg, drawn from the categorical scales so it follows the theme.

constant.$description: true / false / null and named constants.

shadow.$description: Shadow ink per elevation level (tokens/elevation.json); much stronger in dark mode to read on black.
